The all-new Lenovo Legion Infinite, also known as the Y700X, is redefining portable gaming and productivity. Powered by the Snapdragon Elite 8 Gen 5 and featuring a stunning 165Hz OLED display, this tablet delivers top-tier performance for every workload. In this video, we explore its full-fledged Android-based desktop PC mode, utilizing the dual USB-C ports to test mirror and extended display outputs with complete multi-window support.

author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we’re testing out the all-new INIU 10,000mAh Magnetic Power Bank (P791). Don't let its small footprint fool you—while it features 25W MagSafe wireless charging for your iPhone, it can also push a massive 65W over USB-C.

INIU P791 MagSafe Power Bank | 65W Wired: https://amazn.so/ctVe4ji

I test it across multiple devices, including wirelessly charging an iPhone, mounting it directly to the back of a Nintendo Switch using the included magnetic rings, and pushing it to the limit with the ROG Ally X to see if it can maintain that high wattage. With a built-in USB-C lanyard cable and an LCD battery readout, this might be the most versatile EDC power bank for your mobile and handheld gaming setup.
